# Existing Neuromatch course materials

Unmodified selected notebooks from Neuromatch Academy, Computational Neuroscience, pinned to commit `44634e960df7a14cd0bf7398187f2d209d26b0e8`. See `manifest.json` for paths, source URLs, and SHA-256 hashes. Original author credits remain in each notebook.

Content: CC BY 4.0 (`LICENSE.md`); software additionally BSD-3-Clause (`LICENSE-CODE.md`). No endorsement by Neuromatch is implied. These are **upstream reference practicals**, not newly generated substitutes. They are assigned alongside our neuroimaging-specific AI supervision exercises. Their downloads, remote videos/styles and open exercise cells are unchanged; they are excluded from offline execution CI and are not claimed executed here. Use the original hosted course for full supporting media.

- W1D2 Tutorial1: linear regression/model fitting; complete after our least-squares lab.
- W1D2 Tutorial2: likelihood and model fitting; complete after our likelihood lab.
- W1D4 Tutorial1: geometric view of data and orthonormal projection (a precursor to PCA); complete after our SVD/PCA lab.
